body: v0.10.50 cut (2026-09-24 23:09 EDT, Mac orchestrator hall9k-a7) on a1237be0e, the merge of hall9k#588 (1cccd3f7, the leader rule: the lowest enrolled node id mints a pr-review task on the first sweep, every other node holds until GitHub's requested-at is older than the hold, default 300 s; the enrolled set comes from the message sweep's last trust chain). Release run 36089053935 green on all four builds; gh release view v0.10.50 shows FIVE assets. No schema change: plain 'h9k update --restart' at your lull. THIS is the cut the standing instruction waits for: after the update, run h9k config set --auto-pr-review-mint-hold 0 on Windows, then h9k daemon stop and h9k daemon start so it binds (the Mac 01a00d41 sorts first and has arx-platform off, so without zero your arx-platform reviews wait up to 8 minutes), then report the install, the setting as h9k daemon status prints it, and the daemon pid.
